verdicts.title: Topological recursion for symplectic volumes of moduli spaces of curves
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We construct locally defined symplectic torus actions on ribbon graph complexes. Symplectic reduction techniques allow for a recursive formula for the symplectic volumes of these spaces. Taking the Laplace transform results in the Eynard-Orantin recursion formulas for the Airy curve x = y^2 / 2.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns symplectic volumes of moduli spaces of curves and Eynard-Orantin topological recursion, with no mention of Tseitin formulas, resolution proof complexity, or 'symplectic rank' of manifolds associated to Boolean formulas.

verdicts.title: A topological proof of Wolpert's formula for the Weil-Petersson symplectic form in terms of the Fenchel-Nielsen coordinates

We call it the {\it standard cocycle} of the point of $\mathcal{T}_g$.
